Fit a classification model (internal dispatcher)

dot-fit_model.Rd

Fit a classification model (internal dispatcher)

Usage

.fit_model(train_data, var_names, model_type, model_params = list())

Arguments

train_data

Data frame with feature columns + a column named "class" (numeric 0/1).

var_names

Character vector of feature column names.

model_type

One of "GLM", "SVM", "NNET", "RForest".

model_params

Named list of hyperparameter overrides.

Value

A named list: list(model = <fitted object>, model_type = <char>). model is a fitted workflows::workflow for all supported types.
